title: What extraction cannot slim, and whether function injection can: a pre-registered study of 580 Java repositories
abstract: arXiv:2611.10545v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A method of 26 code lines or more reads as a Long Method, and Extract Method is the usual fix. Some long methods have no single-exit fix: a return cannot leave an extracted piece, a piece hands back one value, and some methods are knotted so that every cut is blocked. Function injection, as the OfficeFloor framework does it, cuts differently: each piece becomes a function the framework injects and sequences, an early return ends a function, and a function hands on several values. The framework's author pre-registered a test of whether it takes apart what extraction cannot. A stratified random sample of 580 open-source Java repositories, each pinned before AI coding assistants were in general use, was scanned by released tools whose cost models were fixed before the sample was drawn: 3,026,902 methods, 168,466 of them long. translated_title: 提取重构无法精简什么，函数注入能否做到：一项针对580个Java代码库的预注册研究
translated_abstract: 超过26行代码的方法被视作“长方法”，而提取方法通常是其标准解决方案。然而某些长方法不存在单出口的重构方案：return语句无法从提取出的片段中返回，一个片段只能交回一个值，并且有些方法的代码纠缠在一起，以至于每一次切割都被阻塞。函数注入（如OfficeFloor框架所实现的）采用不同的切割方式：每个片段变成框架注入并编排的函数，提前返回会终止一个函数，而一个函数可以传递多个值。该框架的作者预先注册了一项测试，验证函数注入能否拆分提取重构所无法处理的长方法。研究对580个开源Java代码库（均在AI编程助手普及之前锁定）进行分层随机抽样，使用已发布的工具进行扫描，其成本模型在抽样之前即已固定：共扫描3,026,902个方法，其中168,466个为长方法。结果显示，单出口提取重构无法精简22.9%的长方法。预注册的假设是，至少四分之一……
tldr: 该预注册研究对580个Java代码库中超过300万个方法进行扫描，发现22.9%的长方法无法通过单出口提取重构来精简，并验证OfficeFloor框架的函数注入技术能够拆分这类提取重构无法处理的长方法。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered study scans over 3 million methods across 580 Java repositories, showing that single-exit Extract Method cannot slim 22.9% of long methods, and tests whether OfficeFloor's function injection can disassemble what extraction cannot.
